chapters.title: Sets of finite perimeter
chapters.description: Distributional perimeter, reduced boundary, BV approximation, compactness, coarea, level sets, variational existence, subcalibrations, and minimizing Simons cones.

chapters.title: Currents and flat chains
chapters.description: Mass, compactness, flat chains, pushforwards, homotopies, slicing, Plateau existence, calibrated currents, and singular complex-curve minimizers.

chapters.title: Varifolds
chapters.description: First variation, monotonicity, bounded curvature, constancy, integral compactness, tangent cones, spine splitting, support convergence, qualitative stratification, junction models, and Allard regularity.

chapters.title: Minimal surfaces
chapters.description: Variations, graphs, elliptic estimates, truncated power tests and Moser iteration, Jacobi fields, separated sheets, removable stability, index localization and weak convergence, compactness, geometric inequalities, scalar curvature, Bernstein arguments, and stable cones.

chapters.title: Min-max theory
chapters.description: Pitts, cycle topologies, discrete fineness, almost minimizing limits, existence, concentration control, cohomological detection, compact critical sets, continuous pull-tight deformations, and stationary critical limits.

chapters.title: Volume spectrum and Morse index
chapters.description: Cohomological sweepouts, metric comparison, uniform Weyl asymptotics, multiplicity one, index, and abundance.

chapters.title: Geometric applications of min-max theory
chapters.description: Willmore energy, neck constructions, and low-width model results.

chapters.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces
chapters.description: Area minus volume, CMC min-max, curvature networks, exact volume constraints, strong versus constrained stability, Minkowski identities, constrained Jacobi fields, and sphere rigidity.

chapters.title: Allen-Cahn and phase transitions
chapters.description: Transition profiles, BV compactness and perimeter limits, recovery layers, Modica bounds, stress-energy monotonicity, stability and level geometry, sliding minimization, and planar and three-dimensional rigidity.

chapters.title: Obstacle problems
chapters.description: Variational existence and comparison, reaction measures, optimal interior regularity, quadratic blow-ups, Weiss and Monneau monotonicity, and classical singular strata.

chapters.title: Mean curvature flows
chapters.description: Smooth and weak flows, Gaussian monotonicity, weighted shrinker variations and stability, Gaussian tails and convergence, entropy maximizers, product splitting, and entropy-lowering compact perturbations.

chapters.title: History
chapters.description: Sourced historical notes on the origins of GMT and the development of min-max theory.
